_note: What you see: the welcome card of the setup over the Nextcloud dashboard: what thematiq does in three points, the six steps, and the buttons Skip, Later and Start.
_title_nl: thematiq: eerste keer instellen, stap 1, welkom
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: de welkomstkaart van de setup over het Nextcloud-dashboard: wat thematiq doet in drie punten, de zes stappen, en de knoppen Overslaan, Later en Beginnen.
Thematiq geeft Nextcloud de huisstijl va: Thematiq gives Nextcloud your organisation's house style: colours, fonts, logo and the apps menu, on every screen. You set it up in five short steps. Every choice can be changed later in Administration settings, Theming.
Een tokenset van een Nederlandse overhei: A token set of a Dutch government, or your own set.
Logo, kleuren, favicon en de inlogpagina: Logo, colours, favicon and the login page take over the house style.
Een appmenu op maat: An apps menu made to measure
Apps met payoff, vastzetten in de bovenb: Apps with a payoff, pinning to the top bar and Create.
Alleen beheerders zien dit scherm. Later: Only administrators see this screen. Later closes it; it comes back on the next page you open, until you finish or skip. A Nextcloud that set thematiq up before does not see this.
